verdict.rationale: Vendor marketing implies real-time team collaboration ("Collaborate freely with unlimited teams") but the evidence pack contains no explicit documentation of live cursors or instant sync mechanics, and multiple hands-on reports describe multiplayer editing as crash-prone or unstable when several users work simultaneously on a file. Missing for 10: first-party docs describing live cursor presence/conflict resolution, latency/sync architecture details, and independent confirmation that simultaneous multi-user editing performs reliably at scale.
